event_summary: A black 30 LB kettlebell descends onto a white cup on a wooden tabletop and visibly flattens it.
raw_event_description: At the start, a white cup lies on its side on a wooden tabletop with a black object partially visible near the top edge of the frame. The black kettlebell-shaped object moves downward toward the cup. Its lower round portion contacts the cup, after which the cup changes from a rounded side-lying shape into a flattened, crumpled shape beneath the kettlebell. The kettlebell then remains positioned on top of the flattened cup while the scene stays otherwise still.

reasons: The white cup and tabletop are clearly visible.
The black descending object is only partially visible at the top edge in the first frame.
